note: ★ TONIGHT'S PICK — Tue Nov 24: Dave confirmed Youth for tonight's watch (he called it 'Young' — this Sharon Horgan series, not the 2015 Sorrentino film). Start with E1 'Lockjaw'; 8 episodes, ~30 min each. Sharon Horgan's HBO series (Catastrophe, Bad Sisters): she stars as Alex, a 50-year-old divorced literary agent in London whose son has just left for university — dating again, caring for aging parents, and holding down a publishing career, all at once. A midlife coming-of-age story that's raunchy, self-deprecating, and sneakily moving; ~95% on Rotten Tomatoes. Season 1 ran Sep 20 – Nov 1, 2026, and HBO renewed it for Season 2 the day after the finale. Note: if Dave meant the 2015 Sorrentino film Youth (Michael Caine), say the word and this gets swapped.
